QuestInfo.1: Assistant Cheng dislikes the common cute Teddies in Ludibrium's #bCloud Terrace#k and #bSky Terrace#k. It might have something to do with him getting slapped in the face by one once. After that, he's been telling everyone of the teddies' violent nature and convincing people to get rid of them. Help him out by eliminating #r#o3000005##k, #r#o3110101##k, and #r#o3210203##k. #r100 of each#k should do it.
QuestInfo.2: You have defeated #r100#k #r#o3000005##k, #r#o3110101##k, and #r#o3210203##k monsters each for Assistant Cheng.

0.0: Hey, you over there! Don't just wander around here like that. This area is dangerous. It's full of...teddies.
0.1: I know, I know...it sounds crazy, but look at this mark on my face. I was SLAPPED. By a TEDDY. Do not make the same mistakes I have, friend!
0.2: #eOoh, just thinking about it makes my blood boil!#n\nSpeaking of which, you look like you know how to fight. Think you could give me a hand?

yes.0: See, I'm advancing the #rEliminate Teddies#k campaign as a warning to passing travelers about the #rsavage Teddies#k. But the Teddies are too strong for me, so I need people like you to help out.
yes.1: Do you have the time to take care of r#o3000005##k, #r#o3110101##k, and #r#o3210203##k? #r100 of each#k should do it. I'll be sure to reward you for your troubles!

no.0: You're really not interested? Okay, but beware of the #rTeddies around here#k!

1.0: Ah, you took care of them already?

yes.0: You're not hurt, are you? Good, good.\nI know your efforts have really helped my #rEliminate Teddies#k campaign. I normally only give EXP as a reward, but just for you I've bumped your Fame up, too. Go check it out!
